source: The FSSP seminary's 2026 calendar (fsspolgs.org/liturgical-calendar), commemorations it prints that the universal calendar does not have, read 2026-11-09. To be confirmed against the printed Liturgical Ordo & FSSP Directory, including whether they are kept throughout the Fraternity or only in North America.
toConfirm: Whether the Fraternity has proper feasts of its own that the 2026 page does not show.
The Commemoration of All Holy Popes, printed on Saturday 4 July 2026 as a Mass and a commemoration; its proper date is not clear from one year.
Our Lady of Perpetual Help (27 June) and Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal (27 November) are printed as Masses but not as commemorations; they belong to the Masses an ordo offers, not to this layer.
